status: exact critical-class and nonlinear constraint-rank witness for the massive parity-even Poincare-gauge 0-minus sector

publishedClass.conventions: Yo and Nester parity-even PGT: a0 multiplies scalar curvature, a1,a2,a3 multiply the three irreducible torsion squares, and b1,...,b6 multiply the six irreducible curvature squares; one curvature combination is Bach-Lanczos redundant
publishedClass.projectedKineticCombination: the 0-minus kinetic coefficient is b2+b3, hence b3 on this class
publishedClass.projectedMassCombination: the 0-minus algebraic coefficient is a0/2+a3=(a0-a1)/2 on this class
publishedClass.classification: seven displayed algebraic equalities define a critical surface; its strict health inequalities are open only relative to that surface

positiveNormalizedReduction.action: L_0minus=(A/2) S_mu S^mu+(B/2)(partial_mu S^mu)^2, after positive field/convention rescalings
positiveNormalizedReduction.warning: A/B is the mass in this explicitly stated reduced normalization; irreducible-projector normalization factors must be restored before comparing a numerical mass across PGT convention systems

spectrum.residue: positive in the stated reduced normalization

canonicalWitness.decision: for real m!=0 and nondegenerate spatial volume J>0 this determinant is strictly positive, so the analyzed 0-minus primary-if-constraint block cannot change rank
canonicalWitness.grLimit: at m=0 and p_pi=0 the determinant vanishes; Yo and Nester identify a1=a0 as the massless/pure-gauge case equivalent to GR rather than a continuous extra massless scalar
canonicalWitness.scope: this is a strong nonlinear rank result for the selected scalar-mode class, not a proof for arbitrary matter couplings, added invariants, degenerate tetrads, or every global solution

spin23Map.breaking: e^a=ell A^{a4}, omega^{ab}=A^{ab}, with a fixed-norm selector V^A defining the Lorentz split
spin23Map.a0: the MacDowell-Mansouri/Stelle-West cross term supplies the Einstein-Cartan scalar-curvature coefficient
spin23Map.torsionSquares: the three selector-covariant invariants T^(I)a wedge star T^(I)_a supply a1,a2,a3 and must obey a2=-2a1 and a3=-a1/2
spin23Map.curvatureSquare: the selector-defined pseudoscalar irreducible curvature square supplies b3; the other five displayed curvature coefficients are set to zero
spin23Map.minimalParentFailure: a single T_{mu nu rho}T^{mu nu rho} coefficient generally cannot impose both independent torsion relations, so this class requires the enlarged irreducible invariant basis
spin23Map.selectorAssumption: the selector norm is fixed and no radial or orientation mode propagates; a dynamical selector would add scalar mixing and requires a fresh constraint analysis
spin23Map.vacuumScope: the exact projector point is a torsionless Minkowski result; its reduced 0-minus mode has the AdS stability described in claim 1607, but the full critical PGT projector algebra should still be repeated on the natural Spin(2,3) AdS vacuum

radiativeClosure.reason: the seven zero/equality conditions are not protected by an identified symmetry; matter and graviton/connection loops populate the allowed parity-even invariant basis
radiativeClosure.specificLeak: fermion loops coupled to axial torsion generate a transverse F_S^2 term, leaving the isolated longitudinal critical class
radiativeClosure.classification: a consistent classical tree-level critical sector and a usable low-energy EFT tuning, not presently an open radiatively stable quantum parameter region

stopRules: ADMIT the three-degree-of-freedom spectrum only after all seven critical equalities and a0>a1>0, a1>0, b3/kappa<0 are checked
REJECT the claim that this is an open region of the full PGT coupling space; it is open only within the critical surface
STOP at a0=a1 for a separate gauge-class analysis; do not count a new massless 0-minus particle there
RECOMPUTE the full spin-projector and Dirac system if any forbidden bi is generated or if either torsion equality is relaxed
TREAT radiative departures as EFT counterterms with a cutoff unless a protecting Spin(2,3)-parent symmetry is supplied
REPEAT the full critical-class analysis on AdS before calling it a complete broken-Spin(2,3) vacuum
decision: The local parity-even route is nonempty but critical: it has an explicit healthy massless graviton plus one gapped 0-minus torsion mode, and the relevant nonlinear constraint determinant does not bifurcate for nonzero mass. It is not an open or radiatively closed full-coupling theory, so the strongest defensible endpoint is a classical critical sector or tuned EFT.
